summary: Widget desktop local-first theo dõi sử dụng token, chi phí, giới hạn và hoạt động phiên Across 44+ AI coding tools, hỗ trợ đồng bộ nhiều thiết bị.
usecases: Real-time token and cost monitoring across multiple AI coding platforms
Cross-device sync for developers working on different machines
Local data privacy compliance by keeping usage data on-device
ideas: Integrate with self-hosted analytics dashboards for team-wide usage insights
Add alerting mechanisms for token limit exhaustion or cost overruns
Extend tracking to non-AI desktop applications for generalized usage metrics
